Class ModelReconstructionLoader

java.lang.Object
io.fluxzero.common.api.modeling.ModelReconstructionLoader
public final class ModelReconstructionLoader extends Object
Storage-neutral orchestration for a reconstruction read. Snapshot selection may use a separate storage snapshot: it is an optional acceleration seed, bounded by the selected Model revision. Event reads remain authoritative.

  • Method Details

    • load

      public static GetModelReconstructionResult load(GetModelReconstruction request, Function<GetModelEvents, GetModelEventsResult> events, Function<SearchDocuments, SerializedDocument> snapshots)
      Selects an optional canonical snapshot and a bounded first event page from the same namespace. Each event callback must honor the supplied selector; the snapshot callback may miss concurrent writes. A selected revision that becomes unavailable during the read fails instead of using a snapshot alone.
